Cargo

Tuyau de Cargaison

A flexible hose designed for transferring liquid cargo between ship and shore, constructed and tested for strength and compatibility with the handled product.

Questions and answers

What is Tuyau de Cargaison?

In this glossary, Tuyau de Cargaison refers to: A flexible hose designed for transferring liquid cargo between ship and shore, constructed and tested for strength and compatibility with the handled product.

How is Tuyau de Cargaison used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Terminal au navire : Connectez le tuyau de cargaison au collecteur 2 et assurez-vous que toutes les connexions sont sécurisées avant de commencer le transfert."

Tuyau de Cargaison matters because it supports clear communication in Cargo contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Definition

A flexible hose designed for transferring liquid cargo between ship and shore, constructed and tested for strength and compatibility with the handled product.

Operational example

Terminal to vessel: Connect the cargo hose to manifold 2 and ensure all connections are properly secured before starting transfer.

Localized term

Tuyau de Cargaison

Localized example

Terminal au navire : Connectez le tuyau de cargaison au collecteur 2 et assurez-vous que toutes les connexions sont sécurisées avant de commencer le transfert.
